v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: The Lord hath inclined * his ear unto me.

text.la: Vota mea * Dómino reddam coram omni pópulo eius.
text.en: I will pay my vows * in the sight of all his people.
I have cried to the Lord, * and he hath heard me.

text.la: Auxílium meum * a Dómino, qui fecit cælum et terram.
text.en: My help is from the Lord, * who made heaven and earth.

text.la: Lætátus sum * in his, quæ dicta sunt mihi. ‡
text.en: I rejoiced * at the things that were said to me. ‡

text.la: Non auferétur sceptrum de Iuda, et dux de fémore eius, donec véniat qui mitténdus est; et ipse erit exspectátio géntium.
text.en: The sceptre shall not be taken away from Juda, nor a ruler from his thigh, till he comes that is to be sent, and he shall be the expectation of nations.

v.la: Roráte, cæli, désuper, et nubes pluant iustum.
v.en: Drop down dew, ye heavens, from above, and let the clouds rain the Just.

r.en: Let the earth be opened, and bud forth the Saviour.

text.la: O clavis David * et sceptrum domus Israël; qui áperis, et nemo claudit; claudis, et nemo áperit: veni, et educ vinctum de domo cárceris, sedéntem in ténebris, et umbra mortis.
text.en: O Key of David, * and Sceptre of the house of Israel that openest, and no man shutteth; and shuttest and no man openeth; come to bring out the prisoners from the prison, and them that sit in darkness, and in the shadow of death!

text.la: Excita, quǽsumus, Dómine, poténtiam tuam, et veni: et magna nobis virtúte succúrre; ut per auxílium grátiæ tuæ, quod nostra peccáta præpédiunt, indulgéntia tuæ propitiatiónis accéleret:
text.en: Stir up, we beseech thee, O Lord, thy power, and come; make haste to our aid with thy great might; that, by the help of thy grace, that which is hindered by our sins may be hastened by thy merciful forgiveness.

office.title: Feria II infra Hebd IV Adventus
